DarGlobal > About Us > DISCOVER DARGLOBAL > Overview / Data. Privacy Policy
Introduction
DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.
This Privacy Policy Statement will help you understand how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our site. We would also like to help you make informed decisions based on accurate and clear information, so please read the following to learn how we may use your personal information.
This policy should be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions section of this site.
Acceptance
By using this site, you agree with the DarGlobal Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use this site, and your continued use of DarGlobal website will mean you accept this Privacy Policy.
Information
You may have to register certain information with us to use our services available on this site. The following forms are available on this site to collect personal data that you chose to register to avail of certain services:
EMAIL REGISTRATION Information about DarGlobal, new projects, products and services will be sent periodically through newsletters, updating customers about the latest developments.
CONTACT US The information provided by the customer through the contact tab, will not be stored by www.darglobal.co.uk, and will be used solely to respond to customer inquiries or service requests.
RESIDENTIAL UNIT RESERVATION FORM The information provided in this form will be used only to reserve the concerned property upon customer request.
CREDIT INFORMATION Relevant information about the credit policy of DarGlobal will be provided to the customer upon request, and your credit-information will be kept confidential.
Cookies
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies

DarGlobal > About Us > DISCOVER DARGLOBAL > Overview / Data. We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.
Information Safety​
How safe will my information be?
The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
Information Usage
Who will use this information?
The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 1. In the azure waters of the Arabian Gulf, Al Marjan Island is a premier destination in Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), UAE, offering an exquisite blend of luxury, leisure, and natural beauty. This man-made archipelago, consisting of four coral-shaped islands, provides an idyllic setting for both residents and visitors seeking a unique lifestyle experience. From pristine beaches and luxury resorts to world-class entertainment and dining, Al Marjan Island is a haven for those who appreciate the finer things in life. A Paradise of Luxury Living Al Marjan Island is synonymous with luxury living. Its strategic location, just 60 minutes from Dubai, makes it a convenient retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The island boasts a collection of high-end residential developments, luxury hotels, and resorts that cater to discerning tastes. Whether you are looking for a permanent residence or a vacation home, Al Marjan Island offers a range of properties that embody elegance and sophistication. Discover the Wonders of Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is not just about luxurious living; it is also a destination for leisure and entertainment. The island offers a plethora of attractions and activities that cater to every desire, making it a perfect getaway for families, couples, and solo travelers. The WYNN Resort and Casino

metadata.title: Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE

text: DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 2. One of the most anticipated attractions on Al Marjan Island is the upcoming WYNN Resort and Casino. This world-class entertainment complex will be the first casino in the UAE, bringing a new level of excitement to the island. The WYNN Resort will offer a range of gaming options, luxury accommodations, fine dining, and entertainment, making it a premier destination for those seeking an upscale and thrilling experience. Pristine Beaches and Marine Activities Al Marjan Island is renowned for its pristine beaches, where visitors can bask in the sun and enjoy the crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf. The island’s diverse marine life makes it a haven for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts. For those who prefer to stay above water, kayaking, paddleboarding, and jet skiing are popular activities. The serene environment and stunning sunsets add to the allure of this coastal paradise. Dining and Shopping Al Marjan Island offers a variety of dining options, from casual eateries to fine dining establishments. The island’s restaurants serve a diverse array of cuisines, catering to different tastes and preferences. Whether you are craving Middle Eastern delicacies, international dishes, or fresh seafood, you will find a restaurant that satisfies your palate. The Al Marjan Island Boulevard and Promenade are popular spots for shopping and dining, offering a mix of retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants in a scenic setting. Recreational Activities

metadata.title: Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE

text: DarGlobal > Newsroom > Blog > Discover the Luxury and Leisure of Al Marjan Island, UAE > Part 3. For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, Al Marjan Island provides a range of recreational activities. The island’s lush landscapes and well-maintained paths are perfect for jogging, cycling, and leisurely walks. The Al Marjan Island Amphitheater hosts a variety of events and performances, adding to the island’s vibrant atmosphere. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round at the nearby Al Hamra Golf Club, which offers a challenging course and stunning views. A Convenient and Accessible Location Al Marjan Island’s location makes it easily accessible from major cities and airports. It is just 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 60 minutes from Dubai Mall and the Dubai International Financial Centre. This proximity allows residents and visitors to enjoy the best of both worlds – the tranquility of island living and the excitement of the city. The Astera : A Pinnacle of Luxury and Leisure At the heart of Al Marjan Island’s luxury offerings is The Astera, an exclusive residential project by DarGlobal in collaboration with the legendary automotive brand Aston Martin. The Astera redefines luxury living with its meticulously crafted interiors by Aston Martin, offering an unparalleled blend of elegance, innovation, and craftsmanship. Residents of The Astera enjoy a bespoke lifestyle experience that embodies the essence of luxury living. World-Class Amenities The Astera offers a range of world-class amenities designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. These include an infinity pool with stunning ocean views, a fitness center, an indoor cinema, a multipurpose hall, a yoga lawn, and a spa. With direct beach access, lush green spaces, and a scenic walk track, every aspect of The Astera is crafted to cater to the discerning few who seek the pinnacle of luxury living. DarGlobal is committed, to respecting your privacy and complying with applicable data protection and privacy laws. You can visit https://www.darglobal.co.uk without disclosing your identity information.

Cookies
Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies

DarGlobal > Investor Relations > Investor Relations > Overview / Data. We may collect personal information from you when you use, including but not limited to, the contact options and e-mail. In addition to the personal information we collect, the website server will automatically recognize and store your internet address. In addition, this website may use cookies. Most web browsers are set by default to accept cookies; however, you may set your browser to either accept or refuse cookies. Cookies help websites keep track of personal preferences and recognize return visitors. The cookies are not designed to collect or store information on you, but to deliver targeted content to you online.
Information Safety​
How safe will my information be?
The security of all information associated with our customers is an important concern to us. Therefore, at www.darglobal.co.uk, we exercise the utmost care in providing secure transmission of your information from your own device to our servers. As known, no data transmission over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your information, DarGlobal cannot ensure or warrant the security of any information you transmit to us, or from our online products or services, and you do so at your risk. Once we receive your transmission, DarGlobal uses industry standard efforts to safeguard the confidentiality of your information. However, “perfect security” does not exist on the Internet as known.
Information Usage
Who will use this information?
The general rule is that DarGlobal will not disclose any information that you submit to us (especially your personal information), in a manner that it would link to your identity, except, when we have your explicit permission to disclose it, or under special circumstances, such as when we believe in good faith, that the nature of our relationship or the law requires it.

DarGlobal > Newsroom > News > DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District > Part 1. DarGlobal (LSE: DAR), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, in partnership with Art District Real Estate Development, today announced the start of the collaboration to launch and develop MAD, Muscat Marine, Art & Digital District, a transformative new coastal destination that integrates oceanfront living, luxury hospitality, culture-led enterprise, and future-focused finance and digital industries. Located along Oman’s picturesque coastline, the MAD project spans over 1.5 million square meters with a gross development value of approximately OMR 1.6 billion (USD 4.2 Billion) for all development phases which will span over 12 years. It is designed to elevate the Sultanate’s global standing by merging sea-view living, luxury hospitality, cultural expression, and future financial and digital sectors into one unified ecosystem. Conceived as a multi-destination city, MAD brings together luxury residential communities, cultural venues, world-class marinas, curated retail, next-generation finance and business parks, and premium hotels. The district will invite affluent travelers, global investors, art collectors, tech founders and creative entrepreneurs to live, work and connect within a single, seamless experience rooted in Oman’s maritime identity and economic vision. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, said: “MAD represents a defining step in how Oman’s coastline will be experienced and how its future economy will emerge. Together with Art District Real Estate development, we are building a destination that goes beyond real estate to empower enterprise, attract global talent, support cultural production and unlock new economic value. MAD is a new gateway for Oman, one inspired by the sea and shaped by innovation.”

text: DarGlobal > Newsroom > News > DarGlobal and Art District Real Estate Development Announce MAD, Muscat’s Marine, Art & Digital District > Part 2. At the heart of MAD is a commitment to support Oman’s diversification goals, aligning with the nation’s strategy to grow culture, tourism, technology and high-value finance and investment sectors. The district will host private marinas for mansions, international art exhibitions, digital incubators, a financial center, and a cultural calendar of global events, positioning Muscat as a hub for marine adventure, cultural exchange and financial and digital creativity. This project reflects Oman’s confidence in building industries of the future. MAD showcases how strategic development can preserve our maritime heritage while embracing the opportunities of global innovation. It will attract investment, cultivate talent, and create enduring cultural and economic impact for generations to come.” A defining feature of MAD is the integration of a district-wide digital economy, enabling a new model of property, culture, and enterprise. The development introduces digital licensing, asset exchange, and ecosystem rewards, supporting business formation and investment pathways for global entrepreneurs and investors. “We are creating value beyond physical spaces,” added El Chaar . “MAD is an ecosystem where creators, innovators and investors meet; not only to live or visit, but to participate. That participation defines the future of real estate, and we are proud to shape it in Oman.This partnership demonstrates what Oman stands for; cultural leadership, responsible innovation and global investment confidence. MAD is a testament to what is possible when heritage and ambition come together.”

Can foreigners buy luxury villas in Dubai?
Yes, foreigners can buy homes in Dubai in specially designated freehold areas. The houses convey full ownership rights and are therefore suitable for both residential use and investment.
Can I obtain a 10 year Golden Visa UAE by buying a villa?
Yes, if you invest AED 2 million or more in buying a villa in the UAE, you qualify for the 10-year Golden Visa. The visa allows long-term residence, renewable options, and sponsorship of family members.
Are villas in the UAE a good long-term investment?
Yes, UAE villas are ideal for long-term investment, as they exhibit strong capital growth, no taxation on properties, and high rental returns, resulting in an appreciation of your property value over time.
Benefits of buying a luxury villa in Dubai?
With us, you can buy a villa in Palm Jumeirah, gain access to exclusive gated communities, ultra-luxury amenities, secure investment returns, long-term visa eligibility, excellent connectivity, lifestyle benefits, and enduring prestige.

Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.
